data.one_liner: Model-independent FHIRPath evaluation engine in Dart, port of the Java reference implementation.
data.what_it_does: Evaluates FHIRPath expressions against data models using the FhirNode reflection contract. It provides core parsing, lexing, and expression evaluation for healthcare interoperability standards.
use_when: You need to evaluate FHIRPath expressions across arbitrary FHIR data models
You are building a custom FHIR binding over a non-fhir_r* data model
You need to parse or validate FHIRPath expressions in Dart
avoid_when: You are writing a standard Flutter application and can use version-specific bindings like fhir_r4_path directly
You are not working with healthcare or FHIR interoperability data
strengths: Zero coupling to any specific FHIR version
Direct port of the official Java reference FHIRPath engine
Supports validation and evaluation of expressions via FhirNode contract
weaknesses: Requires a binding or custom implementation of worker contexts for version-specific types
Niche domain-specific utility with no general-purpose application
data.setup_notes: Add to pubspec.yaml and import the package or its bindings.
